title: bardolier volumes rm output
description: What reclaiming one orphan destroyed — a named volume or a leftover data directory (phase 19). cli-spec.md §6 (Volumes / disk). Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

volume.description: The orphan's name — a Docker volume, or <project>/<key> for a data directory.

kind.description: What was reclaimed (phase 19). Absent means volume.

path.description: Host path of a directory orphan; null for a named volume. Additive since phase 19.

removed.description: False when the user declined the confirmation; nothing was touched.

size_bytes.description: Size at the moment of removal; 0 when Docker could not measure it.
